ckpt_name.tooltip: The name of the checkpoint (model) to load.

accumulate.tooltip: Return output_value from every iteration when enabled; otherwise return only the final iteration.

output_value.tooltip: Value returned by End Loop. It returns the final iteration or all iterations according to accumulate.

next_iteration_value.tooltip: Value sent from End Loop back to Start Loop for the next iteration.

terminations.tooltip: Connect outputs that must execute on every iteration. Their values are not returned.

termination.tooltip: Connect a preview or side-effect output that must execute on every iteration. Its value is not returned.

model.tooltip: The model used for denoising the input latent.

seed.tooltip: The random seed used for creating the noise.

steps.tooltip: The number of steps used in the denoising process.

cfg.tooltip: The Classifier-Free Guidance scale balances creativity and adherence to the prompt. Higher values result in images more closely matching the prompt however too high values will negatively impact quality.

sampler_name.tooltip: The algorithm used when sampling, this can affect the quality, speed, and style of the generated output.

scheduler.tooltip: The scheduler controls how noise is gradually removed to form the image.

positive.tooltip: The conditioning describing the attributes you want to include in the image.

negative.tooltip: The conditioning describing the attributes you want to exclude from the image.

denoise.tooltip: The amount of denoising applied, lower values will maintain the structure of the initial image allowing for image to image sampling.

model.tooltip: The diffusion model the LoRA will be applied to.

clip.tooltip: The CLIP model the LoRA will be applied to.

strength_model.tooltip: How strongly to modify the diffusion model. This value can be negative.

strength_clip.tooltip: How strongly to modify the CLIP model. This value can be negative.

brief.tooltip: From Song Brief or Cover Brief.

engine.tooltip: From the music model block (Engine Profile).

detail.tooltip: How compact or rich the lyrics should be.

score.tooltip: The final score: its sections (and for covers its phrasing and tempo) guide the lyrics.

language.tooltip: Detected lyrics language (Transcribe Lyrics); requested only for original-lyrics covers whose brief says 'auto'.

reference_lyrics.tooltip: The source's lyrics draft (Transcribe Lyrics: lyrics); requested only for new-lyrics covers with the phrasing reference. Sectioned lyrics give the writer a syllable target per line.

template.tooltip: Optional target style. Style fields you leave empty are taken from the template.

vocals.tooltip: Instrumental (default), the original lyrics of the source, or new lyrics on its melody.

melody.tooltip: An instrument plays the vocal melody, or accompaniment only.

language.tooltip: Language of the source's lyrics; 'auto' detects it from the singing.

theme.tooltip: What the new lyrics are about.

phrasing_reference.tooltip: Show the writer the source's transcribed lyrics as a phrasing reference (runs the lyrics ASR).

harmony.tooltip: new accompaniment: the source's chords are removed and YuE2 re-harmonises (melody mode). keep original chords: the chords stay (full mode).

title.tooltip: Optional fixed title, e.g. 'Original Title (Jazz Cover)'. Empty: the writer proposes one.

clip.tooltip: CLIP output of the music model's loader.

audio.tooltip: The finished audio (every item of a batch becomes one file).

folder.tooltip: Sub-folder of the ComfyUI output folder.

collision.tooltip: When the file exists: number (add ' (2)'), overwrite, or stop with an error.

reports.tooltip: Reports to include in the release record (Song Sheets, drafts, score tools).

report.tooltip: A Plenio report to include in the record.

score.tooltip: Score in the native two-voice ABC dialect.

operation.tooltip: prepare from brief: sung songs unchanged; instrumental songs get a silent Vocal voice (lead melody moved to Ins, or accompaniment only).

seconds.tooltip: Target length; whole sections are kept, the ending stays.

vocal.tooltip: What happens to the Vocal voice.

conflict.tooltip: When moving: what wins where Ins already plays.

template.tooltip: Optional starting point. Text fields you leave empty are taken from the template.

description.tooltip: What the song is about and how it should sound. Sent to the writing model.

length.tooltip: Target length. Guides the writing and, without a score, the render ceiling.

vocals.tooltip: Sung song or instrumental. Instrumental hides all vocal settings.

melody.tooltip: Whether an instrument carries a lead melody or the song is accompaniment only.

key.tooltip: Optional key, e.g. 'G major'. Music models that use a score take the key from the score.

review.tooltip: stop for review: the documents are released only after you approve them in the editor.

sheet_state.tooltip: Your edits and manual documents (edit them with the Song Sheet editor).

style.tooltip: Style / caption draft for the music model.

context_style.tooltip: Style owned by another sheet; shown and used for the token budget.

context_lyrics.tooltip: Lyrics owned by another sheet; shown and used for the token budget.

context_score.tooltip: Score owned by another sheet; shown, used for the budget and to check the lyrics' sections.

timeline.tooltip: From Transcribe Score: shows bar and section times of the source in the editor.

reference_audio.tooltip: The recording the score was transcribed from: the editor plays it from the selected bar (A/B with the notes). Display only; it never reaches the model.

brief.tooltip: Vocal mode and length for validation.

engine.tooltip: Rules and exact token counts of the loaded music model.

detail.tooltip: summary: readable overview. full: also the raw facts as JSON.

audio.tooltip: The source recording, or a rendered take for the lyrics check.

engine.tooltip: ASR engine (runs in a separate process).

language.tooltip: 'auto' detects the language, or name it (e.g. English, de).

device.tooltip: auto: GPU, falling back to the CPU (about 0.6 x the audio length) with a warning.

score.tooltip: The final score: its sections become the tags.

timeline.tooltip: From Transcribe Score: bar times and where somebody sings.

brief.tooltip: Cover Brief: its lyrics language is used (the language widget is then ignored).

expected_lyrics.tooltip: Lyrics a take was given: turns the node into the sung-lyrics check.

audio.tooltip: The source recording (trim it first for a part of the song).
One take, or the list of takes from a loop (End Loop, accumulate).

audio_encoder.tooltip: SheetSage2 (the cover path's loader can be reused).

tolerance_seconds.tooltip: Seconds of vocal-like notes still accepted. 0 = any vocal note fails (calibrated against the owner's listening, Phase 4A).

filename_prefix.tooltip: The prefix for the file to save. May include formatting tokens such as %date:yyyy-MM-dd%.

format.tooltip: The file format in which to save the audio.

mode.tooltip: full: generates melody and chords; melody: generates melody only, recommended for covers.

num_iterations.tooltip: Number of times to execute the loop body.

start_iteration_index.tooltip: Index of the first iteration when using For loop mode.

max_iteration.tooltip: The exclusive stopping value for iteration_index in For mode.

step.tooltip: The index step size between each iteration when using For loop mode.

list.tooltip: List of items the loop iterates on. The loop body executes once per item.

cache_iterations.tooltip: Reuse unchanged iteration results from previous executions. Disable to execute every iteration again.

parent_iteration.tooltip: Connect iteration_index from an outer Start Loop to nest this loop.

initial_iteration_value.tooltip: Value exposed as current_iteration_value on the first iteration.

video.tooltip: Video frames as image batch. Assumed to be 24 FPS; subsampled to 1 FPS internally.

thinking.tooltip: Operate in thinking mode if the model supports it.

use_default_template.tooltip: Use the built in system prompt/template if the model has one.

mtp.tooltip: Speculative decoding with the checkpoint's multi-token-prediction head. No effect without MTP weights. auto adapts the draft depth; 2-5 pins it. Sampled output stays correctly distributed but differs from non-MTP output for the same seed.

start_index.tooltip: Start time in seconds, can be negative to count from the end (supports sub-seconds).

mode.tooltip: full: generates melody and chords; melody: generates melody only, recommended for covers.

penalty_window.tooltip: Number of recent ABC tokens used to penalize repetition.

abc.tooltip: Connect the ABC generator or supply an edited score. Leave empty to use off mode automatically.

mode.tooltip: full: generates melody and chords; melody: generates melody only, recommended for covers.

max_duration.tooltip: Maximum duration in seconds. Automatically reduced for long prompts; generation can stop earlier.

cfg_scale.tooltip: Autoregressive guidance for style and lyrics. 1.0 disables CFG, matching the ABC workflow. Use 1.01 to match the original off-mode guidance.
